evidence.detail: rs/cache/d extends a fetcher base, implements Runnable, owns multiple request queues/lists, a worker run() loop, request counters and a Socket/InputStream/OutputStream network channel.
The class owns CRC32 state plus version/CRC tables and validates fetched payloads against a trailing version word and computed CRC before accepting cache data.

It owns multiple CacheStoreSet-backed stores for main_file_cache.dat/main_file_cache.idx and main_file_osrs.dat/main_file_osrs.idx, reading/writing requested archive files through the local cache path.

Request methods allocate rs/cache/c records carrying archive/type/id, priority and delivery flags, enqueue them into Node/NodeSub-backed queues, then the worker services pending local or remote requests.
This combined Runnable + request-queue + CRC/version + socket/cache-store responsibility matches the classic client OnDemandFetcher architecture; exact v308 behavior is the primary authority.

proposals.note: OnDemandFetcher is the conservative historical/semantic name for the exact v308 asynchronous cache request engine. Exact bytecode behavior is primary evidence; this does not independently prove the original source identifier.
